# Preface {.unnumbered}

Best practices for software development (and other tasks!) with coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and
similar tools), drawn from two years of daily use.

::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress
This website covers agentic coding at a snapshot in time (October 2026).  The tools are changing
at a rapid pace, and good advice from 6 months ago may be a hindrance with today's models.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Tools we know
My experience is primarily with Claude code, and to a lesser extent Codex.
:::
